gaps.why_now: The freeze-in-C anchors needed explicit governance text before future status changes could be reviewed honestly.

The freeze-map-specific lane note now needs to reflect the active Phase 15 scheduled lane key, the latest visible current-head survey, and the explicit rollback-threshold rule already present in the root policy layer instead of preserving an older maintenance packet marker.
The governance slice needs to remain replayable through the shared Phase 15 build gate.
The convenience make target still keeps the bounded freeze-map governance checks easy to replay.
The root freeze map now needs the retained stay-in-C closeout and no-silent-exception wording that the parity scorecard, review-process note, and indefinite-C policy already depend on.

The freeze-map slice now has to acknowledge that the parity scorecard, Architecture Council review process, and indefinite-C policy family are already landed on current master instead of pointing at a stale follow-up.

The live Phase 15 governance packet now spans the root freeze map, freeze-map governance note, review-process note, and parity scorecard, so the shared review checklist needs one explicit drift gate that keeps the rollback threshold, automatic return-to-blocked trigger, retained discussion state, reopen triggers, and maintenance-mode handoff aligned during maintenance edits.

This lane now needs one explicit roadmap-versus-repo-reality comparison so the freeze-map packet says plainly that the roadmap lists still match the live freeze map and that the same four deep-core blockers remain backed by current Phase 15 and Phase 14 evidence.
The packet-local note and manifest now need to carry the same rollback-threshold rule that the root freeze map already requires for any reopened freeze-in-C review.
The freeze-map packet now needs to restate the already-landed per-anchor lane owner, validation gate, and rollback owner inventory so blocker reviews do not depend on an implicit scorecard lookup.
The live repo still lacks evidence strong enough to move any freeze-in-C anchor out of the current long-term C-owned posture.
